data.title: Govbase is a comprehensive map of online governance
data.claim: Govbase is a comprehensive map of online governance
data.interpretation: Treat Govbase as a substantial, structured source system and research dataset; verify coverage, status, and field completeness for each use.
data.uncertainty: The project describes itself as comprehensive, but the database is crowdsourced and governance ecosystems evolve quickly.

data.title: Govbase models reveal how governance actually works
data.claim: Govbase models reveal how governance actually works
data.interpretation: Use Govbase models as structured orientation and research inputs; supplement them with cases, interviews, and implementation evidence.
data.uncertainty: Documents, entities, structures, and parameters capture formal features but may miss informal authority, culture, conflict, and enforcement.

data.title: Governance automation boundaries
data.claim: Governance automation boundaries
data.interpretation: Document authority, escalation, appeal, override, audit, and shutdown mechanisms before delegating governance work to agents.
data.uncertainty: Routine and constitutional decisions can be difficult to separate, and automated systems may accumulate informal authority.

data.title: Governance simulation versus real authority
data.claim: Governance simulation versus real authority
data.interpretation: Treat game outputs as workshop and learning artifacts unless participants explicitly adopt them through legitimate processes.
data.uncertainty: Games can reveal preferences and tensions but do not themselves establish authority, consent, or enforceable agreements.

data.title: Growth in records demonstrates ecosystem value
data.claim: Growth in records demonstrates ecosystem value
data.interpretation: Report growth alongside commons-health and outcome indicators.
data.uncertainty: Record counts measure output, not usefulness, accuracy, maintenance, reuse, decision quality, or avoided harm.

data.title: Healthy-food production claims prove ecological and health outcomes
data.claim: Healthy-food production claims prove ecological and health outcomes
data.interpretation: Describe practices and claims separately; use territory- and product-specific evidence.
data.uncertainty: Agroecological framing and healthy-food claims require production, input, labor, environmental, nutrition and consumer evidence.

data.title: High average accuracy means an AI system is safe or fair
data.claim: High average accuracy means an AI system is safe or fair
data.interpretation: Report disaggregated performance and institutional consequences; do not infer fairness from aggregate accuracy.
data.uncertainty: Aggregate performance can conceal severe subgroup disparities, threshold effects and unequal consequences.

data.title: High participation means representative participation
data.claim: High participation means representative participation
data.interpretation: Report recruitment, denominator, demographic and affected-party coverage, response patterns, and sampling method alongside participant counts.
data.uncertainty: Large participation counts may still reflect self-selection, digital access, media reach, organized mobilization, or missing demographics.

data.title: Historical software status
data.claim: Historical software status
data.interpretation: Add active, deprecated, or historical status and a last-reviewed date.
data.uncertainty: Repositories and docs may remain visible after products are deprecated or wound down.

data.title: Holistic alternatives should transform every dimension at once
data.claim: Holistic alternatives should transform every dimension at once
data.interpretation: Use the framework to surface relationships and tensions, not to penalize bounded initiatives for lacking total transformation.
data.uncertainty: The framework identifies interconnections but initiatives have different scope, resources, time horizons and strategic roles.

data.title: Human-reviewed means safe for public use
data.claim: Human-reviewed means safe for public use
data.interpretation: Keep review status, sensitivity review, licensing, and public-use approval separate.
data.uncertainty: Accuracy review does not automatically address consent, sensitivity, licensing, affected parties, or contextual harm.

data.title: Hybrid participation is captured completely by the platform
data.claim: Hybrid participation is captured completely by the platform
data.interpretation: Treat platform records as one layer of a broader hybrid process.
data.uncertainty: Organizing, facilitation, negotiation and exclusion may occur off-platform.

data.title: IALA-PR provides current agroecology and land-access infrastructure
data.claim: IALA-PR provides current agroecology and land-access infrastructure
data.interpretation: State the current programs as institutionally described while marking capacity, participants, holdings and outcomes as unverified.
data.uncertainty: Current site describes accompaniment, training, land access, market mapping and a proposed agroecology trust.

data.title: IARAA democratizes agroecological knowledge
data.claim: IARAA democratizes agroecological knowledge
data.interpretation: IARAA is designed to widen access to a curated agroecology corpus; democratic effects remain to be evaluated.
data.uncertainty: The project aims to widen access, but democratization also depends on connectivity, authority, languages, usability, correction, support and who governs the system.

data.title: IARAA is community-controlled because it was developed by popular movements
data.claim: IARAA is community-controlled because it was developed by popular movements
data.interpretation: Describe the named developing organizations and beta status; state decision rights only when directly documented.
data.uncertainty: Movement participation and branding do not by themselves establish who controls corpus, infrastructure, budgets, releases or dispute resolution.

data.title: IARAA is technologically sovereign because movements initiated it
data.claim: IARAA is technologically sovereign because movements initiated it
data.interpretation: Describe movement leadership and separately audit technical dependencies, governance, rights and maintenance.
data.uncertainty: Movement purpose and corpus governance matter, but sovereignty also depends on models, compute, hosting, code, finance, licenses, skills and exit options.

data.title: IARAA reduces dependence on commercial AI
data.claim: IARAA reduces dependence on commercial AI
data.interpretation: IARAA is designed as an alternative oriented toward popular technological sovereignty; actual dependency reduction requires an infrastructure and governance audit.
data.uncertainty: The project states a sovereignty aim, but dependence also includes models, chips, cloud hosting, software libraries, funding and specialist labor.

data.title: Implementation Is Not Pattern
data.claim: Implementation Is Not Pattern
data.uncertainty: Public-use ready as a cautionary principle with caveats
data.notes: Priority: A real-world implementation can produce useful learning, but it should not automatically be treated as a reusable pattern, proof, recommendation, or best practice. · Next: Add to implementation memory guidance; link to Developed Impl Memory; develop full claim record later if needed. · Notes: Batch 1A compact guardrail claim.
data.review_needs: Discovery_Pool promotion — verify claim + evidence

data.title: Implementation is not pattern
data.claim: Implementation is not pattern
data.uncertainty: Do not publish as fact without status/caveats.
data.notes: Priority: Examples do not automatically generalize. · Next: Keep visible as protective claim; link to evidence/source context. · Notes: Integrity-protecting claim.
data.review_needs: Discovery_Pool promotion — verify claim + evidence

data.title: Including marginalized participants makes a process community-led
data.claim: Including marginalized participants makes a process community-led
data.interpretation: Specify who framed the problem, what decisions participants control, how they are resourced and what correction or refusal rights exist.
data.uncertainty: Participation can occur after problem framing and resource decisions are fixed, without authority, compensation or control.

data.title: Inclusion Is Not Endorsement
data.claim: Inclusion Is Not Endorsement
data.uncertainty: Public-use ready as a cautionary principle with caveats
data.notes: Priority: A person, project, organization, tool, source system, concept, or resource appearing in the database does not mean the Toolkit endorses it, recommends it, certifies it, ranks it, or claims formal relationship with it. · Next: Add to workbook overview, public-use cautions, people/source-system guidance, and future public directory methodology. · Notes: Batch 1A compact guardrail claim.
data.review_needs: Discovery_Pool promotion — verify claim + evidence

data.title: Indicators are neutral measurements of what matters
data.claim: Indicators are neutral measurements of what matters
data.interpretation: State why the indicator exists, who selected it, who bears reporting costs and what it leaves out.
data.uncertainty: Selection, aggregation, visibility and decision use embody values and can reshape behavior.

data.title: Indigenous communities are homogeneous or represented by one spokesperson
data.claim: Indigenous communities are homogeneous or represented by one spokesperson
data.interpretation: Use community-defined authority and document scope; do not infer universal consent or viewpoint.
data.uncertainty: Communities contain multiple institutions, roles, generations, genders, knowledge holders and possible disagreements.

data.title: Indigenous monitoring data and public-use boundaries
data.claim: Indigenous monitoring data and public-use boundaries
data.interpretation: Do not assume public summaries grant permission to extract, model or republish underlying knowledge; seek community-defined consent and return paths.
data.uncertainty: Public project pages may expose summaries while underlying files, knowledge and governance remain private or community-controlled.

data.title: Indigenous or community partnership authorizes unrestricted public extraction
data.claim: Indigenous or community partnership authorizes unrestricted public extraction
data.interpretation: Use public materials carefully and seek community or steward review for sensitive details and claims.
data.uncertainty: Organizations may publish about work while communities retain collective rights, cultural protocols or limits on representation.

data.title: Individual consent resolves collective Indigenous rights
data.claim: Individual consent resolves collective Indigenous rights
data.interpretation: Assess collective rights, legitimate authority, jurisdiction and community protocols in addition to individual consent.
data.uncertainty: Indigenous data can concern peoples, lands, cultures, environments and future generations beyond one data subject.

data.title: Initial cohort size proves educational impact
data.claim: Initial cohort size proves educational impact
data.interpretation: Seek cohort, alumni, participant and steward evidence.
data.uncertainty: Enrollment or launch figures do not establish completion, learning, territorial application, livelihood effects or organizational retention.

data.title: Innovation and maintenance are opposites
data.claim: Innovation and maintenance are opposites
data.interpretation: Use maintenance thinking to rebalance lifecycle attention, not to prohibit justified experimentation.
data.uncertainty: New development and maintenance often interact; the problem is systematic underinvestment in upkeep and exaggerated claims about novelty.

data.title: Institutional diversity prevents comparison
data.claim: Institutional diversity prevents comparison
data.interpretation: Use comparison to illuminate differences, patterns, and tradeoffs—not to erase context or rank all systems on one scale.
data.uncertainty: Context matters, but comparative frameworks can still identify recurring variables, dilemmas, and patterns without prescribing one solution.

data.title: Institutional frameworks can be converted directly into database fields
data.claim: Institutional frameworks can be converted directly into database fields
data.interpretation: Use schemas as prompts and containers, preserve narrative context and allow plural or disputed classifications.
data.uncertainty: Formalizing inquiry questions can improve consistency but may flatten ambiguity, tacit knowledge and contested categories.

data.title: Interdependence justifies unpaid care or reduced autonomy
data.claim: Interdependence justifies unpaid care or reduced autonomy
data.interpretation: Pair interdependence with consent, boundaries, compensation, public provision and refusal rights.
data.uncertainty: Interdependence can be romanticized in ways that conceal exploitation, coercion, burnout and inadequate public support.

data.title: Issued soil-carbon credits prove all stated farm and climate benefits
data.claim: Issued soil-carbon credits prove all stated farm and climate benefits
data.interpretation: State the methodology, monitoring period, verification source, issued quantity and uncertainties; treat additional benefits as separate claims.
data.uncertainty: Issuance indicates a registry process under a methodology; it does not independently prove every co-benefit, permanence claim or causal mechanism.

data.title: Just Transition has one fixed definition or owner
data.claim: Just Transition has one fixed definition or owner
data.interpretation: Record lineage, constituency, adaptation and concrete power-shifting commitments.
data.uncertainty: Labor, environmental-justice, Indigenous and policy actors use the term differently.

data.title: Knowledge behaves like a natural common-pool resource
data.claim: Knowledge behaves like a natural common-pool resource
data.interpretation: Analyze the specific resource characteristics, community, infrastructure, rights, and dilemmas rather than transferring natural-resource models directly.
data.uncertainty: Knowledge can be non-rival, replicable, legally enclosed, infrastructurally scarce, privacy-sensitive, or costly to maintain; its dilemmas differ from forests or fisheries.

data.title: Knowledge commons are inherently small, noncommercial or anti-market
data.claim: Knowledge commons are inherently small, noncommercial or anti-market
data.interpretation: Treat scale, commercial relations and institutional form as empirical variables rather than defining exclusions.
data.uncertainty: GKC cases include large-scale science, markets, corporations, smart cities, platforms, industry and hybrid institutional arrangements.

data.title: KOI is decentralized because it does not store all source data centrally
data.claim: KOI is decentralized because it does not store all source data centrally
data.interpretation: Describe which components are distributed, who controls each node and interface, and where authority or single points of failure remain.
data.uncertainty: Reference-based architecture can reduce copying while access control, keys, indexing, model interfaces, and stewardship may remain concentrated.

data.title: KOI transforms scattered documents into a knowledge brain
data.claim: KOI transforms scattered documents into a knowledge brain
data.interpretation: KOI indexes and retrieves distributed Regen ecosystem materials; outputs remain dependent on source coverage, processing quality, permissions, and review.
data.uncertainty: Large-scale indexing and semantic retrieval do not ensure accuracy, representation, understanding, or responsible use.

data.title: La Vía Campesina has one unified position on every issue
data.claim: La Vía Campesina has one unified position on every issue
data.interpretation: Describe positions as movement declarations or specified regional/member positions; preserve dissent and scope.
data.uncertainty: A transnational movement includes autonomous regions, constituencies and member organizations with different contexts and debates.

data.title: La Vía Campesina represents a single unified peasant voice
data.claim: La Vía Campesina represents a single unified peasant voice
data.interpretation: Attribute positions to the movement document, assembly or member organization that issued them; do not infer total unanimity.
data.uncertainty: The movement spans regions, constituencies, organizations and political contexts with internal differences and autonomous members.

data.title: Lived-experience reports are either mere anecdotes or complete proof
data.claim: Lived-experience reports are either mere anecdotes or complete proof
data.interpretation: Treat lived experience as essential evidence with stated scope; combine it with technical, policy and institutional investigation.
data.uncertainty: Reports can reveal harms and institutional patterns while still requiring transparent methods, corroboration and protection of reporters.

data.title: Local technical training guarantees sustainable maintenance
data.claim: Local technical training guarantees sustainable maintenance
data.interpretation: Treat training as one component of a funded maintenance ecosystem.
data.uncertainty: Training alone does not provide wages, spare parts, governance, time, support or succession.

data.title: Localism Fund and BioFi collaboration
data.claim: Localism Fund and BioFi collaboration
data.interpretation: Represent program design, partners, and stated goals separately from local consent, equitable distribution, and ecological outcomes.
data.uncertainty: Place-based and bioregional funding claims can imply community legitimacy or ecological benefit without affected-party or outcome evidence.

data.title: Low-disclosure intake eliminates access and privacy risks
data.claim: Low-disclosure intake eliminates access and privacy risks
data.interpretation: Collect the minimum needed, restrict access, allow changes and deletion, and evaluate the lived process.
data.uncertainty: Participants may still face pressure to explain needs, and operational preferences can reveal sensitive information.

data.title: Mainstreaming participation improves democratic quality
data.claim: Mainstreaming participation improves democratic quality
data.interpretation: Institutionalization can improve continuity when participation has authority, resources, accountability, and meaningful community influence.
data.uncertainty: Embedding participation can increase continuity and influence, but can also formalize weak or performative processes.

data.title: Maintenance is politically neutral routine work
data.claim: Maintenance is politically neutral routine work
data.interpretation: Treat maintenance as technical, social, economic, and political work with distributional consequences.
data.uncertainty: Maintenance decisions determine whose systems are kept functioning, whose risks are prioritized, and whose labor is valued.

data.title: Making the database accessible will automatically broaden participation
data.claim: Making the database accessible will automatically broaden participation
data.interpretation: Accessibility is necessary for broader participation but not sufficient; review material and governance conditions separately.
data.uncertainty: Accessibility may remove barriers but participation also depends on trust, compensation, authority, language, relevance and political context.

data.title: Mapping alternatives is politically neutral
data.claim: Mapping alternatives is politically neutral
data.interpretation: Treat mapping as governance; provide source attribution, consent, sensitivity controls, correction and removal pathways.
data.uncertainty: Selection, categories, location precision, prominence and public exposure can affect safety, legitimacy, funding and movement relationships.

data.title: Matching names or URLs prove two rows are the same entity
data.claim: Matching names or URLs prove two rows are the same entity
data.interpretation: Treat string matching as a duplicate signal and require object-type, timeline, governance, and primary-source review.
data.uncertainty: Names, domains, handles, projects, and organizations can overlap or change; one entity can also use several names.

data.title: Membership creates collaborative synergy among funded projects
data.claim: Membership creates collaborative synergy among funded projects
data.interpretation: The round tested consortium membership as a curation and field-building condition; any resulting synergy should be evaluated through project and network evidence.
data.uncertainty: The GG19 announcement presents consortium membership as an experiment; it does not establish that membership improved collaboration or outcomes.

data.title: Mentor expertise transfers cleanly across contexts
data.claim: Mentor expertise transfers cleanly across contexts
data.interpretation: Treat mentorship as situated guidance; preserve local decision authority and document adaptation or rejection of advice.
data.uncertainty: Cross-context mentoring can be valuable, but advice may not fit local institutions, culture, power relations, risk, or political timing.

data.title: Metadecidim has solved sustainable governance
data.claim: Metadecidim has solved sustainable governance
data.interpretation: Treat it as an important experiment with unresolved sustainability questions.
data.uncertainty: Its own process documents volunteer overload, funding dependence and labor challenges.

data.title: Metadecidim represents the full Decidim ecosystem
data.claim: Metadecidim represents the full Decidim ecosystem
data.interpretation: Treat Metadecidim as the open governance community and inspect power distribution separately.
data.uncertainty: Open participation does not ensure equal presence or influence across users, vendors, municipalities and maintainers.

data.title: Methodology version and review status
data.claim: Methodology version and review status
data.interpretation: Record exact document version, date, review stage, status, and supersession relationship before reuse.
data.uncertainty: Initial submissions, internal reviews, expert reviews, public-comment drafts, revisions, and published versions may coexist in the library.

data.title: Model and measurement uncertainty
data.claim: Model and measurement uncertainty
data.interpretation: Present estimates with methodology, confidence limits or uncertainty treatment, monitoring cadence, and known limitations.
data.uncertainty: Soil carbon, biodiversity, avoided emissions, and ecosystem-service estimates depend on sampling, baselines, models, counterfactuals, leakage, permanence, and uncertainty treatment.

data.title: Model farms prove ecological performance
data.claim: Model farms prove ecological performance
data.interpretation: Record the practice, scale, duration, evidence and uncertainty separately.
data.uncertainty: Demonstration plots show practices and learning environments, not necessarily long-term ecological or economic outcomes.

data.title: Modular, interoperable, composable, and inclusive design enables reuse everyw…
data.claim: Modular, interoperable, composable, and inclusive design enables reuse everywhere
data.interpretation: These principles can support adaptation, but reuse across communities requires local review, resources, consent, and implementation learning.
data.uncertainty: Technical or conceptual modularity does not guarantee cultural transferability, accessibility, maintenance, or inclusion.

data.title: Modularity makes Decidim politically neutral
data.claim: Modularity makes Decidim politically neutral
data.interpretation: Decidim is modular, but configuration choices are political and should be reviewable.
data.uncertainty: Spaces, components, permissions, phases, verification and thresholds embed governance choices.

data.title: More connectivity produces digital inclusion
data.claim: More connectivity produces digital inclusion
data.interpretation: Connectivity is one condition of inclusion; evaluate meaningful access, agency, risks and outcomes separately.
data.uncertainty: Access, affordability, skills, device quality, relevance, safety, language, disability and power shape meaningful use.

data.title: More contributors automatically make the knowledge commons more legitimate
data.claim: More contributors automatically make the knowledge commons more legitimate
data.interpretation: Assess who participates, what rights they have, whose knowledge is missing, and how decisions and corrections work.
data.uncertainty: Contributor count does not establish representativeness, accountability, care, review quality, or affected-party participation.

data.title: More data automatically improves justice or representation
data.claim: More data automatically improves justice or representation
data.interpretation: Ask whether data should be collected, who controls it, which decisions it enables and what refusal or deletion rights exist.
data.uncertainty: Expanded data collection can increase surveillance, exposure and institutional control while preserving harmful categories.

data.title: More database records indicate a healthier knowledge commons
data.claim: More database records indicate a healthier knowledge commons
data.interpretation: Use record counts only as activity measures and pair them with maintenance, review, workload, accessibility, correction, and use evidence.
data.uncertainty: Growth may coexist with stale links, thin sources, reviewer debt, invisible labor, exclusion, or low reuse.

data.title: More explicit structure always increases trust
data.claim: More explicit structure always increases trust
data.interpretation: Assess who defines the structure, who bears its burdens, who can contest it and how it affects trust in practice.
data.uncertainty: Explicit structure can support accountability but can also enable surveillance, coercion, exclusion or bureaucratic domination.

data.title: More information always improves system performance
data.claim: More information always improves system performance
data.interpretation: Improved information flows may help when they are timely, usable, trusted, rights-respecting and connected to action.
data.uncertainty: Information can aid coordination but may also create overload, surveillance, gaming, conflict or unequal power.

data.title: More participants means deliberation has scaled successfully
data.claim: More participants means deliberation has scaled successfully
data.interpretation: Assess scaling out alongside scaling up, across, deep, and in, with context-specific evidence.
data.uncertainty: Participation numbers capture only one dimension and may conceal weak quality, limited influence, poor inclusion, or no institutional effect.

data.title: More sharing is always socially beneficial
data.claim: More sharing is always socially beneficial
data.interpretation: Evaluate appropriate information flows, boundaries, consent, exit, voice, affected outsiders, and negative externalities.
data.uncertainty: Sharing can create privacy, security, extraction, surveillance, misinformation, appropriation, inequity and community-control risks.

data.title: More transparent allocation mechanisms produce better public-goods outcomes
data.claim: More transparent allocation mechanisms produce better public-goods outcomes
data.interpretation: These systems make parts of allocation more visible; outcome quality must be evaluated through implementation and evidence.
data.uncertainty: Transparency can improve reviewability but does not by itself improve selection, implementation, maintenance or outcomes.

data.title: Movement education practices can be copied as generic facilitation methods
data.claim: Movement education practices can be copied as generic facilitation methods
data.interpretation: Extract questions and principles cautiously; do not reproduce symbolic or pedagogical practices without context and permission.
data.uncertainty: Pedagogy is embedded in political organization, history, territory, culture, discipline and relationships.

data.title: Movement-led agroecology schools strengthen food sovereignty
data.claim: Movement-led agroecology schools strengthen food sovereignty
data.interpretation: La Vía Campesina uses agroecology schools and peasant-to-peasant processes as movement-building and knowledge-sharing infrastructure; effects should be assessed case by case.
data.uncertainty: Schools may build knowledge and organization, but outcomes vary by resources, land access, political conditions and sustained support.

data.title: Movement media can be used as independent outcome evidence
data.claim: Movement media can be used as independent outcome evidence
data.interpretation: Label them as movement-generated primary sources and triangulate consequential outcome claims.
data.uncertainty: Movement publications are crucial primary sources for self-understanding and implementation memory but have an advocacy and organizational role.

data.title: Movement media is representative of all members
data.claim: Movement media is representative of all members
data.interpretation: Preserve speaker role, date, selection process and dissent or missing constituencies.
data.uncertainty: Recorded voices reflect selected speakers, editorial choices and event contexts.

data.title: Movement media visibility is not representative authority
data.claim: Movement media visibility is not representative authority
data.interpretation: Store dated role and exact episode context.
data.uncertainty: Interviewees and hosts may be contributors or spokespeople without authority to represent whole regions or constituencies.

data.title: Movement-run school equals community control
data.claim: Movement-run school equals community control
data.interpretation: Document rules-in-use and decision rights separately.
data.uncertainty: Movement affiliation does not by itself establish who controls curriculum, land, budgets, admissions, credentials, research or staffing.

data.title: Movement-school network is not one curriculum
data.claim: Movement-school network is not one curriculum
data.interpretation: Keep school-level records and avoid universal outcome claims.
data.uncertainty: IALAs share broad principles but differ in context, governance, duration, resources and pedagogy.

data.title: MST can be represented through one leader or spokesperson
data.claim: MST can be represented through one leader or spokesperson
data.interpretation: Record specific roles and sources; preserve collective and constituency voices rather than personifying the movement.
data.uncertainty: A large decentralized movement contains sectors, territories, leadership bodies and internal differences.

data.title: MST cooperative scale proves democratic and equitable livelihoods
data.claim: MST cooperative scale proves democratic and equitable livelihoods
data.interpretation: Treat scale as an organizer-reported network signal and review individual cooperatives and federation governance.
data.uncertainty: Counts of cooperatives, associations and productive chains do not establish rules-in-use, labor conditions, income distribution or member power.

data.title: MST is one centralized organization with one voice
data.claim: MST is one centralized organization with one voice
data.interpretation: Represent specific units, roles, sources and scopes; avoid attributing every statement or practice to the entire movement.
data.uncertainty: The movement contains territorial communities, state and regional structures, national coordination, sectors, collectives and diverse constituencies.

data.title: Multistakeholder participation balances power
data.claim: Multistakeholder participation balances power
data.interpretation: Treat multistakeholderism as an arrangement to analyze, not proof of legitimacy or equality.
data.uncertainty: Stakeholders may differ greatly in funding, access, agenda-setting power and state or corporate authority.

data.title: Mutual aid can compensate for insufficient institutional funding
data.claim: Mutual aid can compensate for insufficient institutional funding
data.interpretation: Separate institutional obligations from voluntary reciprocal support.
data.uncertainty: Informal solidarity cannot reliably replace salaries, public services, access budgets or organizational duties.

data.title: Mutual aid can replace public services or durable institutions
data.claim: Mutual aid can replace public services or durable institutions
data.interpretation: Describe mutual aid as complementary movement and community infrastructure, not an automatic substitute for public responsibility.
data.uncertainty: Grassroots support can be vital, but volunteer networks may lack resources, continuity, legal authority or universal coverage.

data.title: Mutual aid is costless or infinitely scalable
data.claim: Mutual aid is costless or infinitely scalable
data.interpretation: Track care labor, compensation, safety, capacity, accountability and relationships with public systems.
data.uncertainty: Informal response can depend on unpaid labor, burnout, risk exposure and uneven access to resources.

data.title: Named movement spokespeople represent the whole Puerto Rico agroecology ecosy…
data.claim: Named movement spokespeople represent the whole Puerto Rico agroecology ecosystem
data.interpretation: Keep collective and multi-organizational records primary and date all public roles.
data.uncertainty: Sources show public roles, not comprehensive representative mandates.

data.title: Naming a feedback loop establishes causality
data.claim: Naming a feedback loop establishes causality
data.interpretation: Treat feedback diagrams as testable causal propositions and seek disconfirming evidence.
data.uncertainty: A plausible loop may omit confounders, contested mechanisms, nonlinearities or actor strategy.

data.title: Naming care as a value means contributors are supported
data.claim: Naming care as a value means contributors are supported
data.interpretation: Describe the actual budgets, roles, support pathways, workload limits and repair practices.
data.uncertainty: Care language can coexist with unpaid labor, overload, poor boundaries and weak accountability.

data.title: Nearly one thousand documents means the knowledge base is comprehensive
data.claim: Nearly one thousand documents means the knowledge base is comprehensive
data.interpretation: State the organizer-reported corpus size as a scale signal and separately evaluate coverage and exclusion.
data.uncertainty: Corpus size does not establish geographic, linguistic, epistemic, gender or practice coverage, nor current accuracy.

data.title: Network member directory and portals
data.claim: Network member directory and portals
data.interpretation: Use public member information only for scoped discovery with attribution and public-use review; avoid inferred affiliations and social ranking.
data.uncertainty: People and organizational affiliations can be misread, scraped, ranked, or treated as consent for public profiling.

data.title: Network membership implies agreement with the umbrella organization
data.claim: Network membership implies agreement with the umbrella organization
data.interpretation: Represent membership as a relationship, not endorsement or identical viewpoint.
data.uncertainty: Members and associates may share broad commitments while differing in priorities, politics, methods and positions.

data.title: Network-of-networks governance is automatically decentralized
data.claim: Network-of-networks governance is automatically decentralized
data.interpretation: Describe formal and informal coordination, resources and visibility power rather than equating distributed membership with equal power.
data.uncertainty: Facilitation, funding, language, travel, publishing and digital infrastructure can concentrate influence even without formal central authority.

data.title: Networks of grounded alternatives can support transformation by connecting is…
data.claim: Networks of grounded alternatives can support transformation by connecting isolated initiatives
data.interpretation: These systems intentionally connect alternatives; assess concrete collaborations, resource flows and outcomes separately.
data.uncertainty: Connection may support solidarity and learning, but network effects, durability and political influence require evidence.

data.title: Nyéléni declarations prove implementation or unanimous agreement
data.claim: Nyéléni declarations prove implementation or unanimous agreement
data.interpretation: Treat declarations as movement-authored agendas and trace implementation separately by region and organization.
data.uncertainty: Declarations express collective political direction after consultation but do not establish identical adoption, enforcement or outcomes.

data.title: Offline or low-connectivity communities are deficient
data.claim: Offline or low-connectivity communities are deficient
data.interpretation: Avoid deficit framing; document desired services, constraints, choices and community-defined wellbeing.
data.uncertainty: Universal-development narratives can erase deliberate refusal, cultural priorities and alternative communication systems.

data.title: On-chain ecological data is verified ecological truth
data.claim: On-chain ecological data is verified ecological truth
data.interpretation: Regen Ledger can anchor supporting data and record attestations; ecological validity still depends on data quality, methodology, reviewer competence, and context.
data.uncertainty: On-chain anchoring records a content hash and timestamp; it does not by itself establish the truth or quality of the underlying data.

data.title: One justice-centered thinker cluster resolves the graph’s bias
data.claim: One justice-centered thinker cluster resolves the graph’s bias
data.interpretation: Treat the sixth cluster as a correction and bridge, followed by distinct lineages with their own sources and governance.
data.uncertainty: Design Justice addresses major gaps but cannot substitute for Indigenous sovereignty, disability justice, labor, feminist data work or diverse Global South traditions.

data.title: One public leader represents the whole movement
data.claim: One public leader represents the whole movement
data.interpretation: Record the person’s specific role, date and source; preserve collective and constituency authorship.
data.uncertainty: Public figures may have historic or current roles but cannot stand in for autonomous territories, sectors, women, youth, LGBTI+ members, cooperatives or allied movements.

data.title: Open access creates a healthy knowledge commons
data.claim: Open access creates a healthy knowledge commons
data.interpretation: Describe access separately from governance quality, contributor rights, stewardship, and collective outcomes.
data.uncertainty: Access is only one dimension; governance, contribution, maintenance, quality, privacy, legitimacy, and correction also matter.

data.title: Open access is always the most commons-aligned choice
data.claim: Open access is always the most commons-aligned choice
data.interpretation: Use differentiated access and public-use states; explain restrictions and review them periodically.
data.uncertainty: Some resources involve privacy, cultural context, safety, licensing, political risk, or affected-party interests.

data.title: Open access is sufficient for productive and sustainable knowledge sharing
data.claim: Open access is sufficient for productive and sustainable knowledge sharing
data.interpretation: Open access is one possible condition within a broader governance system; evaluate how the commons is produced, maintained and governed.
data.uncertainty: Access may matter, but sustainability also depends on creation, curation, maintenance, norms, infrastructure, roles, incentives, law, privacy, legitimacy and conflict resolution.

data.title: Open civic innovation produces resilient and participatory civic systems
data.claim: Open civic innovation produces resilient and participatory civic systems
data.interpretation: Open civic innovation is an articulated practice and design framework intended to support participatory, resilient civic systems; outcomes depend on implementation and context.
data.uncertainty: The framework expresses a theory of practice, not established causal evidence across communities.

data.title: Open cooperatives align enterprise with the commons
data.claim: Open cooperatives align enterprise with the commons
data.interpretation: Open cooperativism proposes enterprise forms oriented toward shared resources and social benefit; evaluate each organization empirically.
data.uncertainty: The model aspires to alignment, but actual ownership, labor, governance, licensing, and surplus distribution vary.

data.title: Open data and open knowledge are inherently decolonial or equitable
data.claim: Open data and open knowledge are inherently decolonial or equitable
data.interpretation: Separate openness from legitimacy; apply community authority, purpose, benefit, responsibility and ethics review.
data.uncertainty: Open publication can conflict with collective rights, cultural authority, privacy, benefit sharing and the right not to disclose.

data.title: Open data and open source automatically produce public participation
data.claim: Open data and open source automatically produce public participation
data.interpretation: State what is open and assess who can use it, contribute, influence decisions and sustain it.
data.uncertainty: Availability can improve reuse but does not overcome exclusion, literacy, disability, language, trust, time or institutional responsiveness.

data.title: Open data makes the process fully transparent
data.claim: Open data makes the process fully transparent
data.interpretation: Treat open data as one evidence layer within a wider institutional record.
data.uncertainty: Vote and statement data do not capture recruitment, facilitation, moderation, private negotiations, legal drafting, or affected-party experience.

data.title: Open guides can be copied safely into another community
data.claim: Open guides can be copied safely into another community
data.interpretation: Use guides as starting points and adapt through local governance and expert review.
data.uncertainty: Technical, legal, cultural, ecological and organizational conditions vary substantially.

data.title: Open licenses override Indigenous cultural and intellectual property protocols
data.claim: Open licenses override Indigenous cultural and intellectual property protocols
data.interpretation: Display legal license and community protocols separately; unresolved conflict requires review and possible restriction.
data.uncertainty: Western copyright and open licenses may not recognize collective, intergenerational or culturally specific rights and responsibilities.

data.title: Open publication makes peasant seeds and territorial knowledge freely reusable
data.claim: Open publication makes peasant seeds and territorial knowledge freely reusable
data.interpretation: Treat public availability as a discovery signal; review collective rights, consent, provenance and community-defined conditions before reuse or AI ingestion.
data.uncertainty: Collective rights, customary rules, biodiversity governance and community protocols may limit appropriate reuse even when information is public.

data.title: Open publication of a critical framework makes it universally safe to reuse
data.claim: Open publication of a critical framework makes it universally safe to reuse
data.interpretation: Reuse the framework with attribution and contextual translation; do not claim certification or affected-community approval.
data.uncertainty: Open access supports learning but does not erase context, attribution, community relationships or domain limitations.

data.title: Open-source civic infrastructure is automatically a commons
data.claim: Open-source civic infrastructure is automatically a commons
data.interpretation: Assess licensing, governance, contributor power, funding, maintenance and user/community decision rights separately.
data.uncertainty: Code availability does not establish shared governance, sustainable maintenance, equitable access or community control.

data.title: Open-source civic infrastructure is automatically community governed
data.claim: Open-source civic infrastructure is automatically community governed
data.interpretation: Describe software freedom separately from project governance, deployment control, maintenance capacity, and user influence.
data.uncertainty: Open code can coexist with concentrated technical capacity, funding dependence, vendor control, institutional authority, or inaccessible governance.

data.title: Open-source civic technology guarantees democratic control
data.claim: Open-source civic technology guarantees democratic control
data.interpretation: Assess software governance, deployment context, data rights, participation, facilitation and institutional accountability separately.
data.uncertainty: Open code improves inspectability and reuse but does not determine hosting, access, facilitation, agenda-setting, institutional response or community power.

data.title: Open-source code ensures community control
data.claim: Open-source code ensures community control
data.interpretation: Separate software freedom from control over infrastructure, data and decisions.
data.uncertainty: Deployments still depend on hosting, maintainers, administrators, funding and governance.

data.title: Open source is not automatically maintained or responsible
data.claim: Open source is not automatically maintained or responsible
data.uncertainty: Do not publish as fact without status/caveats.
data.notes: Priority: Open code still needs maintainer sustainability and safety. · Next: Keep visible as protective claim; link to evidence/source context. · Notes: Integrity-protecting claim.
data.review_needs: Discovery_Pool promotion — verify claim + evidence

data.title: Open source makes a civic platform publicly accountable
data.claim: Open source makes a civic platform publicly accountable
data.interpretation: State the license, maintainers, hosting, governance, contribution process, auditability, and practical accessibility separately.
data.uncertainty: Source visibility supports inspection and reuse but does not guarantee understandable governance, inclusive contribution, security, or public control.

data.title: Open-source or civic technology is inherently liberatory
data.claim: Open-source or civic technology is inherently liberatory
data.interpretation: Assess ownership, control, access, labor, harms and institutional context rather than inferring justice from openness or civic purpose.
data.uncertainty: Tools and design sites can reproduce domination through access barriers, labor structures, surveillance, governance and institutional use.

data.title: Open-source residency outputs are automatically public goods
data.claim: Open-source residency outputs are automatically public goods
data.interpretation: Describe the output, license, users, maintenance state, and evidence of benefit separately.
data.uncertainty: Licensing and publication do not establish usefulness, safety, maintenance, accessibility, or public benefit.

data.title: Open-source software is sustainably maintained
data.claim: Open-source software is sustainably maintained
data.interpretation: State repository, license, maintainers, funding, activity, support model, security process, and deprecation plan separately.
data.uncertainty: Code availability does not establish funded maintenance, security, documentation, support, governance, or succession.

data.title: Open-source Toolkit infrastructure guarantees portability and community control
data.claim: Open-source Toolkit infrastructure guarantees portability and community control
data.interpretation: Assess code, data, credentials, documentation, governance, financing, and exit pathways separately.
data.uncertainty: Code access does not establish hosting access, data export, documentation, operational knowledge, funding, or decision rights.

data.title: OpenCivics is a decentralized solidarity network
data.claim: OpenCivics is a decentralized solidarity network
data.interpretation: OpenCivics describes itself as a community of practice and decentralized solidarity network; the distribution of decision rights and operational control should be reviewed separately.
data.uncertainty: Decentralized can describe identity or aspiration without showing actual distribution of authority, funding, infrastructure, or agenda-setting.

data.title: OpenCivics organizational naming
data.claim: OpenCivics organizational naming
data.interpretation: Preserve each artifact and organizational layer separately, with current status and relationship fields rather than assuming one unified institution.
data.uncertainty: Network, Consortium, Labs, Fund/Foundation, Commons, Wiki, Portal, and Swarm materials can be conflated as one legal or governance entity.

data.title: Openly available source material can be freely merged and republished
data.claim: Openly available source material can be freely merged and republished
data.interpretation: Store source licenses and reuse constraints; prefer factual metadata and paraphrase where necessary.
data.uncertainty: Public availability does not establish compatible licensing, consent, or safe reuse.

data.title: Openly editable means equally accessible and participatory
data.claim: Openly editable means equally accessible and participatory
data.interpretation: Describe formal editability separately from actual contributor diversity and accessibility.
data.uncertainty: Contribution still depends on internet access, language, research skills, confidence, time, and familiarity with academic or civic terminology.

data.title: Opinion groups are real constituencies
data.claim: Opinion groups are real constituencies
data.interpretation: Treat groups as analytical patterns within a specific conversation, not fixed identities, communities, or political blocs.
data.uncertainty: Clusters are generated from voting patterns and may change as participation or statements change.

data.title: Option is not recommendation
data.claim: Option is not recommendation
data.uncertainty: Do not publish as fact without status/caveats.
data.notes: Priority: Reusable options need context and review. · Next: Keep visible as protective claim; link to evidence/source context. · Notes: Integrity-protecting claim.
data.review_needs: Discovery_Pool promotion — verify claim + evidence

data.title: Options Are Not Recommendations
data.claim: Options Are Not Recommendations
data.uncertainty: Public-use ready as a cautionary principle with caveats
data.notes: Priority: An option in the Toolkit is a possible workflow, pattern, mechanism, structure, or design choice. It should not be treated as a recommendation unless it has been reviewed for a specific context. · Next: Add to guardrail set; link to all Developed Options; develop full claim record later if needed. · Notes: Batch 1A compact guardrail claim.
