data.title: Oral knowledge can be safely converted into text and added to the corpus
data.claim: Oral knowledge can be safely converted into text and added to the corpus
data.interpretation: Require community authority, purpose limitation, attribution, compensation, sensitivity controls and withdrawal before inclusion.
data.uncertainty: Oral knowledge can be collective, contextual, sacred, gendered, territorial or inappropriate for unrestricted retrieval.

data.title: Organización Boricuá is a current island-wide movement source system
data.claim: Organización Boricuá is a current island-wide movement source system
data.interpretation: Treat it as a current movement source system while marking membership, regions and governance as requiring direct confirmation.
data.uncertainty: Recent direct and movement sources show continuing public activity and Puerto Rico-wide identity.

data.title: Organizer-reported reach is not independently verified impact
data.claim: Organizer-reported reach is not independently verified impact
data.interpretation: Preserve date and source; avoid converting representation estimates into beneficiary counts.
data.uncertainty: Counts of organizations, countries and represented people signal scale but not participation quality or outcomes.

data.title: Ostrom proved that local communities always govern commons better than states…
data.claim: Ostrom proved that local communities always govern commons better than states or markets
data.interpretation: Ostrom showed that communities can govern some commons effectively under particular institutional and contextual conditions.
data.uncertainty: Her work challenged universal state-or-market assumptions and documented institutional diversity; it did not establish local self-governance as universally superior.

data.title: Ostrom’s natural-resource design principles can be directly applied to knowle…
data.claim: Ostrom’s natural-resource design principles can be directly applied to knowledge commons
data.interpretation: Use Ostrom as an important lineage while applying the GKC framework’s distinct empirical questions to knowledge, data and information.
data.uncertainty: Knowledge and information differ from many biophysical common-pool resources, and GKC explicitly cautions against treating IAD or design principles as automatic starting points or conclusions.

data.title: Parent-child classification proves legal ownership or governance control
data.claim: Parent-child classification proves legal ownership or governance control
data.interpretation: Use precise relationship types and state the evidence and scope of governance or stewardship.
data.uncertainty: Projects, collaborations, publications, and tools can be associated without being owned or governed by one parent.

data.title: Participant counts show representativeness
data.claim: Participant counts show representativeness
data.interpretation: Report counts with recruitment, access limitations and institutional scope.
data.uncertainty: Registrations, votes and interactions measure activity, not whether participants reflect affected populations.

data.title: Participation activity metrics measure democratic quality
data.claim: Participation activity metrics measure democratic quality
data.interpretation: Report activity metrics with participation quality, representativeness, institutional effect, accessibility and later outcomes.
data.uncertainty: Registrations, votes, proposals, meetings, comments, cohorts or trained practitioners are activity and reach signals, not outcome measures.

data.title: Participation counts demonstrate policy influence
data.claim: Participation counts demonstrate policy influence
data.interpretation: Connect participation metrics to decision rules, demographic and access context, accepted proposals, implementation tracking, and participant feedback.
data.uncertainty: Registrations, proposals, votes, meetings, and page views measure activity, not whose input shaped decisions or whether results were implemented.

data.title: Participatory-action research is automatically non-extractive
data.claim: Participatory-action research is automatically non-extractive
data.interpretation: Audit authority across the full research lifecycle.
data.uncertainty: Participation can remain tokenistic if communities do not control questions, data, interpretation, publication and withdrawal.

data.title: Participatory data stewardship guarantees community control
data.claim: Participatory data stewardship guarantees community control
data.interpretation: Record actual authority, governance rights, value distribution, exit and enforcement mechanisms.
data.uncertainty: Participation can be consultative while ownership, legal control, infrastructure and revenue remain elsewhere.

data.title: Participatory democracy increases trust, learning, equity, and government res…
data.claim: Participatory democracy increases trust, learning, equity, and government responsiveness
data.interpretation: Participatory processes can produce several positive effects under some conditions; assess each process and evidence base separately.
data.uncertainty: The site summarizes research suggesting positive effects, but outcomes vary by design, authority, recruitment, implementation, and political context.

data.title: Patronage points are equivalent to wages or guaranteed returns
data.claim: Patronage points are equivalent to wages or guaranteed returns
data.interpretation: Describe patronage as a contingent ownership distribution mechanism and report wages, expenses, and profitability separately.
data.uncertainty: Patronage depends on profit, cooperative rules, and future distributions; it does not replace fair current compensation.

data.title: Payment makes a contribution process non-extractive
data.claim: Payment makes a contribution process non-extractive
data.interpretation: Assess compensation together with workload, consent, authority, privacy, maintenance and remediation.
data.uncertainty: Pay can coexist with excessive scope, coercive publication, unsafe data collection or symbolic authority.

data.title: PCC impact figures independently prove movement outcomes
data.claim: PCC impact figures independently prove movement outcomes
data.interpretation: Attribute figures to PCC and avoid treating them as independent proof of job quality, survival, or democratic control.
data.uncertainty: Reported project, country, and worker-reach figures are useful organizational signals but require definitions, methods, and independent verification.

data.title: Peace and agrarian reform claims are politically neutral
data.claim: Peace and agrarian reform claims are politically neutral
data.interpretation: Retain authorship, political context, time and multiple relevant sources.
data.uncertainty: Movement positions emerge from a contested conflict, labor and land context and should not be flattened into generic policy summaries.

data.title: Peasant agroecology can be replicated through technical training alone
data.claim: Peasant agroecology can be replicated through technical training alone
data.interpretation: Agroecological practices may transfer selectively, but movement agroecology depends on rights, organization, livelihoods, seeds and local ecology.
data.uncertainty: Movement sources frame agroecology as political, cultural, organizational and territorial—not only a production technique.

data.title: Peasant seed materials are unrestricted open knowledge
data.claim: Peasant seed materials are unrestricted open knowledge
data.interpretation: Treat public campaign materials as visible advocacy; seek explicit authority before reusing detailed knowledge or data.
data.uncertainty: Seed knowledge can be collective, territorial, culturally governed and vulnerable to appropriation or enclosure.

data.title: Peer-to-peer architecture is inherently egalitarian
data.claim: Peer-to-peer architecture is inherently egalitarian
data.interpretation: P2P structures may enable broader contribution; equity depends on governance, resources, access, and power relations.
data.uncertainty: Distributed participation can still reproduce unequal expertise, access, ownership, labor, visibility, and decision power.

data.title: People Powered membership validates an organization or practitioner
data.claim: People Powered membership validates an organization or practitioner
data.interpretation: Record membership as a relationship signal; evaluate practice and outcomes separately.
data.uncertainty: Membership indicates network participation and field involvement, not accreditation, effectiveness, integrity, or community legitimacy.

data.title: Place-based and Indigenous knowledge
data.claim: Place-based and Indigenous knowledge
data.interpretation: Do not assume public availability equals permission for extraction or republication; preserve consent, sovereignty, attribution, and local governance boundaries.
data.uncertainty: Ecological methodologies may involve local communities, land stewards, culturally sensitive locations, species data, and Indigenous knowledge.

data.title: Plain language means removing complexity
data.claim: Plain language means removing complexity
data.interpretation: Use layered communication: concise plain-language orientation linked to fuller detail and sources.
data.uncertainty: Oversimplification can erase uncertainty, conflict, technical detail and affected-party context.

data.title: Platform cooperatives create fairer digital work
data.claim: Platform cooperatives create fairer digital work
data.interpretation: Platform cooperatives are designed to increase democratic ownership and control; labor and business outcomes must be assessed case by case.
data.uncertainty: Cooperative ownership may improve bargaining, autonomy, and surplus distribution, but outcomes vary by market, capital, governance, regulation, and worker participation.

data.title: Platform verification
data.claim: Platform verification
data.interpretation: Display exact status, source, date, and scope; do not label as generally validated.
data.uncertainty: Verified or eligible status is bounded to platform rules.

data.title: Plural technologies strengthen democracy
data.claim: Plural technologies strengthen democracy
data.interpretation: Plurality offers a design vision for technology that supports collaboration across diversity; democratic effects require implementation evidence.
data.uncertainty: The claim is normative and programmatic; actual effects vary by technology, institution, access, governance, and political context.

data.title: Plurality technologies can strengthen democracy by bridging social difference
data.claim: Plurality technologies can strengthen democracy by bridging social difference
data.interpretation: Plurality proposes relationship-centered technologies for collaboration across difference; democratic effects require independent evidence.
data.uncertainty: This is the project's central normative claim, drawing on Taiwan examples and multiple technical traditions, but effects vary by context and implementation.

data.title: Pluriversal approaches allow many worlds to coexist
data.claim: Pluriversal approaches allow many worlds to coexist
data.interpretation: Pluriversal approaches seek to preserve multiple ways of knowing and living while requiring explicit processes for conflict, rights and accountability.
data.uncertainty: This is a normative and political orientation, not evidence that conflicts, domination or incompatibilities disappear.

data.title: Pluriverse means every worldview or practice is equally just or beyond critique
data.claim: Pluriverse means every worldview or practice is equally just or beyond critique
data.interpretation: Use pluriversal analysis to resist universalism while retaining justice, affected-party and evidence review.
data.uncertainty: Respect for multiple worlds does not eliminate power, harm, internal conflict or the need for accountability.

data.title: Policy playbooks prove implementation
data.claim: Policy playbooks prove implementation
data.interpretation: Classify resources as proposals, adopted policies, implementations or evaluated cases.
data.uncertainty: Collaboratively developed resources document strategies and proposals, not necessarily enacted or evaluated outcomes.

data.title: Polis consensus items directly became law
data.claim: Polis consensus items directly became law
data.interpretation: Use an item-level crosswalk among consensus statements, agency commitments, legal text, and enforcement before claiming direct translation.
data.uncertainty: A reported government pledge and later policy change do not establish one-to-one incorporation or sole causation.

data.title: Polis discovers the public will
data.claim: Polis discovers the public will
data.interpretation: Polis maps patterns among participating responses and can surface cross-group agreement; it does not automatically represent an entire public.
data.uncertainty: Results depend on recruitment, prompt design, statement supply, moderation, participation patterns, model assumptions, and interpretation.

data.title: Polis scales deliberation to hundreds of thousands or millions
data.claim: Polis scales deliberation to hundreds of thousands or millions
data.interpretation: Polis is designed for very large-scale open-ended feedback; each deployment should separately evaluate participation, quality, and decision linkage.
data.uncertainty: Technical participant capacity does not establish deliberative quality, representativeness, accessibility, or institutional effect.

data.title: Political education about caste and gender proves equitable outcomes
data.claim: Political education about caste and gender proves equitable outcomes
data.interpretation: State that caste and gender were addressed in documented training; assess outcomes separately with affected participants.
data.uncertainty: Curriculum content does not establish redistribution of land, income, safety, leadership or decision authority.

data.title: Political formation is not measured learning outcome
data.claim: Political formation is not measured learning outcome
data.interpretation: Seek participant-defined outcomes and longitudinal follow-up.
data.uncertainty: Course completion or graduation does not establish later territorial practice, leadership or livelihood effects.

data.title: Polycentricity means decentralization is automatically good
data.claim: Polycentricity means decentralization is automatically good
data.interpretation: Describe the centers, authorities, interactions, accountability, resources, and outcomes rather than using polycentric as a positive label.
data.uncertainty: Multiple centers can improve experimentation and fit, but can also create inequality, conflict, opacity, duplication, and coordination failure.

data.title: Popular agrarian reform links ecological transition to land and social power
data.claim: Popular agrarian reform links ecological transition to land and social power
data.interpretation: Describe it as MST’s framework and examine implementation, counterarguments and territorial evidence.
data.uncertainty: This is a movement political framework, not a universally accepted causal conclusion.

data.title: Post-development or decolonial language guarantees non-extractive practice
data.claim: Post-development or decolonial language guarantees non-extractive practice
data.interpretation: Assess governance, resource flows, authorship, consent, material benefit and community authority rather than relying on labels.
data.uncertainty: Critical language can coexist with extractive research, unequal funding, token participation or external agenda-setting.

data.title: Practitioner support programs prove democratic outcomes
data.claim: Practitioner support programs prove democratic outcomes
data.interpretation: Document program support separately from participation quality, policy influence and community outcomes.
data.uncertainty: Training, networks and resources can build capacity but outcomes depend on institutions, power, participation design and follow-through.

data.title: Precision and non-harming must be designed together
data.claim: Precision and non-harming must be designed together
data.interpretation: CSIS frames precision and non-harming as mutually necessary commitments; apply and test that framing in context.
data.uncertainty: This is the suite's foundational normative commitment, not an empirically settled universal law.

data.title: Preferred synthesized wording is neutral
data.claim: Preferred synthesized wording is neutral
data.interpretation: Record the synthesis editor, AI assistance, contributing rows, review scope, and unresolved conflicts.
data.uncertainty: Choosing, combining, and rewriting source descriptions changes emphasis and can hide disagreement.

data.title: Preserving source rows reduces the risk of irreversible merge errors
data.claim: Preserving source rows reduces the risk of irreversible merge errors
data.interpretation: An immutable import ledger makes merge decisions more reviewable and reversible.
data.uncertainty: Preservation supports audit, correction, alternative synthesis, and recovery from mistaken canonicalization.

data.title: Producer or beneficiary counts demonstrate equitable livelihood gains
data.claim: Producer or beneficiary counts demonstrate equitable livelihood gains
data.interpretation: State the reported count and separately identify what benefit means and how it is distributed.
data.uncertainty: Counts do not reveal income distribution, prices, debt, gendered control, labor burden or unequal value capture.

data.title: Product awards validate cooperative or social impact
data.claim: Product awards validate cooperative or social impact
data.interpretation: Present awards as external recognition signals with clearly bounded scope.
data.uncertainty: Awards may reflect product quality or market recognition but not governance, livelihoods or ecological performance.

data.title: Programmable governance makes communities more democratic
data.claim: Programmable governance makes communities more democratic
data.interpretation: PolicyKit can help communities author and execute procedures; governance quality depends on who writes the rules, who is affected, and how rules are challenged.
data.uncertainty: The ability to encode procedures does not establish participation quality, legitimacy, inclusion, or fair outcomes.

data.title: Project and Fund leaderboard effects
data.claim: Project and Fund leaderboard effects
data.interpretation: Treat leaderboard rank as a platform-specific funding and attention outcome; examine concentration, newcomer access, campaign burden, and distribution across projects.
data.uncertainty: Multiplicative rankings combine money raised, match unlocked, and Boost Points, potentially amplifying popularity, wealth, early momentum, and campaign capacity.

data.title: Project developer, monitor and administrator role concentration
data.claim: Project developer, monitor and administrator role concentration
data.interpretation: Display each role and identify where independent review or verification enters the process.
data.uncertainty: One organization may perform several roles in the evidence and issuance chain.

data.title: Project-status drift
data.claim: Project-status drift
data.interpretation: Record current status and last-reviewed date; do not present historical or paused projects as maintained tools.
data.uncertainty: The portfolio includes active, seeking-participants, pending-funding, paused, complete, and exploratory projects.

data.title: Prominent facilitators are the authors or representatives of collective alter…
data.claim: Prominent facilitators are the authors or representatives of collective alternatives
data.interpretation: Record scoped facilitation and authorship relationships while foregrounding participating movements, communities and co-authors.
data.uncertainty: Public-facing thinkers and facilitators may become proxies for movements, obscuring collective authorship and local knowledge.

data.title: Public audio is not unrestricted training data
data.claim: Public audio is not unrestricted training data
data.interpretation: Review license, consent, purpose, safety and withdrawal before reuse.
data.uncertainty: Public availability does not automatically permit AI ingestion, voice cloning or cross-context reuse.

data.title: Public audio may be freely transcribed or used for AI
data.claim: Public audio may be freely transcribed or used for AI
data.interpretation: Record licensing, consent, cultural and security constraints before reuse.
data.uncertainty: Public access does not establish permission for bulk transcription, model training, voice cloning or derivative use.

data.title: Public community archives and AI use
data.claim: Public community archives and AI use
data.interpretation: Preserve data-policy context, do not assume public discussion equals unrestricted reuse, and apply stronger review to person-level or sensitive material.
data.uncertainty: Public Slack channels may be archived, referenced, or processed under stated data policies.

data.title: Public farm videos are unrestricted reusable knowledge commons
data.claim: Public farm videos are unrestricted reusable knowledge commons
data.interpretation: Record item-level license, attribution, consent, cultural authority and noncommercial restrictions before reuse.
data.uncertainty: The archive states a CC BY-NC 3.0 Puerto Rico license for project works, with separate copyright notices and contextual knowledge concerns.

data.title: Public human-rights records are safe to aggregate
data.claim: Public human-rights records are safe to aggregate
data.interpretation: Use minimization, redaction, delayed publication and steward-led threat review.
data.uncertainty: Combining names, affiliations, incidents and territories can increase profiling and security risks even when each item is public.

data.title: Public is not automatically commons
data.claim: Public is not automatically commons
data.uncertainty: Do not publish as fact without status/caveats.
data.notes: Priority: Public availability does not imply governance/stewardship. · Next: Keep visible as protective claim; link to evidence/source context. · Notes: Integrity-protecting claim.
data.review_needs: Discovery_Pool promotion — verify claim + evidence

data.title: Public Is Not Automatically Public-Use-Ready
data.claim: Public Is Not Automatically Public-Use-Ready
data.uncertainty: Public-use ready as cautionary principle with caveats; do not treat as fully externally reviewed framework.
data.notes: Priority: Information being publicly accessible does not automatically mean it is safe, appropriate, ethical, reviewed, or contextually ready to reuse in a public-facing Toolkit, database, map, directory, agent, website, or report. · Next: Add as core structural integrity principle; use before public-facing database, directory, graph, website, or agent-readable registry work. · Notes: Added in Batch 1A Claims update.
data.review_needs: Discovery_Pool promotion — verify claim + evidence

data.title: Public movement media is safe for unrestricted AI ingestion
data.claim: Public movement media is safe for unrestricted AI ingestion
data.interpretation: Use item-level consent, licensing, minimization, safety and withdrawal review before computational reuse.
data.uncertainty: Audio, images, testimony and event records may include personal, territorial or culturally sensitive information.

data.title: Public participation should always be maximized
data.claim: Public participation should always be maximized
data.interpretation: Clarify who should participate, what can be public, which rights and risks apply, and where non-public governance is justified.
data.uncertainty: Some decisions require privacy, delegated authority, protected knowledge, emergency action or bounded participation; more openness can create harm or extraction.

data.title: Public role ≠ current role
data.claim: Public role ≠ current role
data.interpretation: Store source date and reverify before outreach or strong present-tense claims.
data.uncertainty: Movement responsibilities can rotate or change after the publication date.

data.title: Public seed knowledge is unrestricted open data
data.claim: Public seed knowledge is unrestricted open data
data.interpretation: Apply collective-rights, provenance, permission and restricted-use review before publication or AI use.
data.uncertainty: Seed knowledge may carry collective rights, cultural protocols, ecological sensitivity and risks of privatization or biopiracy.

data.title: Published Indigenous governance information is open for reuse
data.claim: Published Indigenous governance information is open for reuse
data.interpretation: Apply authority-first review, purpose limitation and withdrawal or correction pathways.
data.uncertainty: Public availability does not remove collective authority, customary law, consent, cultural restrictions or safety concerns.

data.title: Puerto Rico food-sovereignty work can be separated from colonial infrastructure
data.claim: Puerto Rico food-sovereignty work can be separated from colonial infrastructure
data.interpretation: Retain colonial and infrastructure context while acknowledging diverse Puerto Rican political positions.
data.uncertainty: Recent movement sources connect dependency, disaster capitalism, trade, land and political status.

data.title: Putting researchers, builders, funders, and policymakers in one room produces…
data.claim: Putting researchers, builders, funders, and policymakers in one room produces aligned infrastructure
data.interpretation: Funding the Commons intentionally convenes cross-sector actors; whether this produces durable alignment should be evaluated through later collaborations and implementations.
data.uncertainty: The convening model may improve connection, but alignment and durable collaboration require evidence after the event.

data.title: Quarterly project updates verify donor impact
data.claim: Quarterly project updates verify donor impact
data.interpretation: Project updates are implementation and accountability signals; review their evidence, scope and authorship separately.
data.uncertainty: Recurring updates improve transparency but remain project-authored narratives unless independently reviewed.

data.title: Radical transparency is always democratic
data.claim: Radical transparency is always democratic
data.interpretation: Use transparency with consent, minimization, redaction, accessibility and contextual review.
data.uncertainty: Public transcripts and records improve legibility but can create privacy, safety, chilling-effect, context-collapse and information-overload risks.

data.title: RAG prevents hallucinations or guarantees correct agroecology guidance
data.claim: RAG prevents hallucinations or guarantees correct agroecology guidance
data.interpretation: Describe RAG as an evidence-support architecture and require citations, refusal behavior, field testing and correction records.
data.uncertainty: Retrieval can improve grounding but still fails through bad sources, retrieval errors, chunking, synthesis, model behavior and missing context.

data.title: Rapid database growth demonstrates a healthy commons
data.claim: Rapid database growth demonstrates a healthy commons
data.interpretation: Assess maintenance capacity, contributor wellbeing, correction responsiveness and actual use alongside growth.
data.uncertainty: Growth can coexist with review debt, burnout, stale records and unmaintainable scope.

data.title: Readable canonical IDs are always better
data.claim: Readable canonical IDs are always better
data.interpretation: Use stable type-neutral identifiers and maintain readable slugs and names separately.
data.uncertainty: IDs that encode object type or name can become unstable when classification or preferred naming changes.

data.title: RealFi infrastructure is more grounded than DeFi
data.claim: RealFi infrastructure is more grounded than DeFi
data.interpretation: RealFi is an FtC program frame for tools intended to address real-world financial and coordination needs; groundedness must be assessed project by project.
data.uncertainty: The program framing emphasizes actual needs and friction, but projects still require user, legal, safety, and implementation review.

data.title: Reciprocity means everyone gives and receives equally
data.claim: Reciprocity means everyone gives and receives equally
data.interpretation: Use reciprocity as shared commitment and relationship, not equal exchange at every moment.
data.uncertainty: People have different capacities, needs, risks and time horizons; strict equivalence can exclude disabled, poor or crisis-affected participants.

data.title: Reduced purchased inputs necessarily improve household wellbeing
data.claim: Reduced purchased inputs necessarily improve household wellbeing
data.interpretation: Assess costs, labor, income, nutrition, debt, access and benefit distribution separately.
data.uncertainty: Lower input costs may coexist with higher labor burdens, market constraints, land inequality or uneven benefits.

data.title: Referencing CSIS, CRAFT, CROSS or WALKRI means the Toolkit conforms to them
data.claim: Referencing CSIS, CRAFT, CROSS or WALKRI means the Toolkit conforms to them
data.interpretation: Describe standards as review sources or experimental inputs unless an explicit conformance assessment has been completed and independently checked.
data.uncertainty: A citation, prompt run or partial use does not establish conformance to a specification.

data.title: Regen AI is planetary intelligence infrastructure
data.claim: Regen AI is planetary intelligence infrastructure
data.interpretation: Regen AI is an emerging collaboration building AI and knowledge infrastructure for the Regen ecosystem; current components and coverage should be named specifically.
data.uncertainty: The phrase is a mission and architecture claim that may overstate current deployment, coverage, and governance maturity.

data.title: Regional declarations do not erase island and language differences
data.claim: Regional declarations do not erase island and language differences
data.interpretation: Preserve country, language and organization-level context.
data.uncertainty: A regional statement can obscure differences across territories, colonial statuses and languages.

data.title: Regional hubs represent all practitioners or communities in a region
data.claim: Regional hubs represent all practitioners or communities in a region
data.interpretation: Describe the hub’s actual members, scope, activity, and governance; do not treat it as regional representation by default.
data.uncertainty: Hub membership and activity may not reflect the diversity, geography, or political conditions of an entire region.

data.title: Regional reports are neutral measurements
data.claim: Regional reports are neutral measurements
data.interpretation: Cite the specific report, author, method and limits; use reports as evidence sources, not neutral mirrors.
data.uncertainty: Indicators, issue selection, authorship, methods and recommendations reflect institutional choices and available evidence.

data.title: Remote participation is a temporary pandemic accommodation
data.claim: Remote participation is a temporary pandemic accommodation
data.interpretation: Remote participation is longstanding disability knowledge and should remain a durable option rather than an emergency exception.
data.uncertainty: Disabled communities practiced remote access long before COVID-19 and continue to develop it as ongoing social and political infrastructure.

data.title: Remote participation is automatically accessible
data.claim: Remote participation is automatically accessible
data.interpretation: Document the specific remote-access supports, remaining barriers and participant feedback.
data.uncertainty: Remote formats can still exclude through inaccessible platforms, fatigue, time zones, captions, bandwidth, surveillance or rigid pacing.

data.title: Renewable energy equals energy democracy
data.claim: Renewable energy equals energy democracy
data.interpretation: Assess ownership, governance, utility power, rates, labor, land and distribution of benefits.
data.uncertainty: A project can be renewable while ownership, labor, siting and benefits remain centralized or inequitable.

data.title: Representation caution
data.claim: Representation caution
data.interpretation: Preserve ecosystem plurality and disagreement.
data.uncertainty: https://anamuri.cl/
data.context: Movement ecosystems are plural and sometimes contested.

data.title: Research funding versus research validation
data.claim: Research funding versus research validation
data.interpretation: Describe funding and presentation status precisely; review outputs separately for evidence, method, and intended use.
data.uncertainty: Receiving a grant or presenting in a seminar may be misread as endorsement or peer validation.

data.title: Research synthesis findings are universal effect sizes
data.claim: Research synthesis findings are universal effect sizes
data.interpretation: Present synthesized findings with study scope, heterogeneity, confidence, and conditions.
data.uncertainty: The source combines studies with different designs, contexts, outcomes, and quality.

data.title: Residency participation means a prototype became deployable or maintained
data.claim: Residency participation means a prototype became deployable or maintained
data.interpretation: Treat residency completion as an implementation milestone; separately document repositories, adoption, maintenance, funding, and failures.
data.uncertainty: Programs describe advancement, open-source outputs, and showcases, but later use and maintenance are not established by completion.

data.title: Resilience is always a desirable outcome
data.claim: Resilience is always a desirable outcome
data.interpretation: Specify resilience of which system functions, for whom, over what period and with what distributional effects.
data.uncertainty: Resilience can sustain harmful institutions, exclusion or extractive arrangements.

data.title: Retired ecocredits prove the claimed ecological outcome occurred
data.claim: Retired ecocredits prove the claimed ecological outcome occurred
data.interpretation: Credit retirement is a registry event tied to a specific issued batch; outcome confidence depends on methodology, project evidence, verification, uncertainty, and ongoing monitoring.
data.uncertainty: Retirement records asset use and prevents further transfer under the system; it is not independent proof that all ecological claims are accurate.

data.title: Rights recognition equals protection
data.claim: Rights recognition equals protection
data.interpretation: Track implementation, institutions, cases and protection outcomes separately.
data.uncertainty: Formal international rights do not ensure domestic enforcement, safety or access to remedy.

data.title: Rough consensus means everyone agrees
data.claim: Rough consensus means everyone agrees
data.interpretation: Document agreement thresholds, disagreement, recruitment, agenda setting and unresolved stakes.
data.uncertainty: Consensus-finding may surface bridging statements without resolving minority rights, nonparticipation, power or implementation conflict.

data.title: Seasonal-worker rights materials remain current indefinitely
data.claim: Seasonal-worker rights materials remain current indefinitely
data.interpretation: Retain publication date and jurisdiction and obtain current legal review before operational use.
data.uncertainty: Labor law, social-security rules, pesticide regulation and institutional contacts can change.

data.title: Security failure and historical documentation
data.claim: Security failure and historical documentation
data.interpretation: Preserve the GIVfarm exploit, governance response, retirement status and continuing contract-access instructions as implementation memory.
data.uncertainty: Current product summaries can omit adverse history, deprecated systems and user-exit obligations.

data.title: Seed-saving documentation can be openly extracted into AI systems
data.claim: Seed-saving documentation can be openly extracted into AI systems
data.interpretation: Require item-level rights, consent and culturally appropriate governance before AI reuse.
data.uncertainty: Educational publication and a public license do not erase community authority, attribution or noncommercial limits.
data.context: Agroecología en Puerto Rico / Mi Casa

data.title: Seed-sharing knowledge is unrestricted open knowledge
data.claim: Seed-sharing knowledge is unrestricted open knowledge
data.interpretation: Treat seed knowledge as situated and collectively governed; seek explicit permission for reuse and AI access.
data.uncertainty: Public descriptions do not erase community authority, cultural protocols, farmer rights or risks from extraction and patenting.

data.title: Semantic interoperability preserves meaning and values automatically
data.claim: Semantic interoperability preserves meaning and values automatically
data.interpretation: Document schema mappings, provenance, governance assumptions, lossiness, and public-use boundaries alongside technical interoperability.
data.uncertainty: Cross-system translation can preserve structure while losing context, authority, consent, or normative constraints.

data.title: Sembradoras de Esperanza is only a technical agriculture school
data.claim: Sembradoras de Esperanza is only a technical agriculture school
data.interpretation: Describe technical and political-pedagogical dimensions together, while avoiding claims beyond available outcome evidence.
data.uncertainty: Movement sources frame it as political, feminist and agroecological formation embedded in food-sovereignty struggles.

data.title: Sensor ingestion and community privacy
data.claim: Sensor ingestion and community privacy
data.interpretation: Define source-specific permissions and public-use boundaries; public accessibility alone should not imply unrestricted AI ingestion or republication.
data.uncertainty: Forum, chat, social, personal, and community sources carry different expectations of access, consent, retention, and downstream use.

data.title: Shashe and Amrita Bhoomi demonstrate plural forms of movement-owned agroecolo…
data.claim: Shashe and Amrita Bhoomi demonstrate plural forms of movement-owned agroecology education
data.interpretation: Treat them as complementary implementation cases whose principles and questions may inform other contexts.
data.uncertainty: The public record supports distinct, long-running movement-school models, but not a universal template or comparative ranking.

data.title: Shashe demonstrates that movement-owned agroecology education can support ter…
data.claim: Shashe demonstrates that movement-owned agroecology education can support territorial transformation
data.interpretation: Shashe is an evidence-bearing case of movement-linked education and territorial agroecological change; stronger impact claims require local, ecological and livelihood review.
data.uncertainty: The public record supports a strong implementation narrative but remains incomplete on causality and distributional outcomes.

data.title: Signing the Design Justice Principles certifies just practice
data.claim: Signing the Design Justice Principles certifies just practice
data.interpretation: Treat signatory status as a public commitment signal; review actual governance, labor, outcomes and affected-party experience separately.
data.uncertainty: The Network describes principles as commitments and a living document, not a certification or audited standard.

data.title: Social-derived relationships establish formal affiliation
data.claim: Social-derived relationships establish formal affiliation
data.interpretation: Record the exact observed relationship and source; avoid inferring broader affiliation.
data.uncertainty: Mentions, reposts, event participation, and shared publications may suggest a relationship without proving employment, partnership, endorsement, or governance authority.

data.title: Social Signal Is Not Endorsement
data.claim: Social Signal Is Not Endorsement
data.uncertainty: Public-use ready as cautionary principle with caveats; do not treat as fully externally reviewed framework.
data.notes: Priority: A social signal can be useful for discovery, but it should not be treated as endorsement, evidence, ranking, importance, legitimacy, or proof of quality. · Next: Add as core structural integrity principle; use before any public-facing people/source-system/resource list from social-signal data. · Notes: Added in Batch 1A Claims update.

data.title: Solidarity brigades are automatically reusable disaster-response models
data.claim: Solidarity brigades are automatically reusable disaster-response models
data.interpretation: Assess host authority, safety, labor accounting, follow-up and who carries the organizing burden before reuse.
data.uncertainty: Historical and 2025 sources document collective labor, farm visits, learning and mutual support, but not complete outcome or burden-distribution evidence.

data.title: Source-Linked Is Not Reviewed

data.title: Source-system stewards should control all records about their systems
data.claim: Source-system stewards should control all records about their systems
data.interpretation: Invite steward review and corrections while preserving independent evidence, criticism, and transparent disagreement.
data.uncertainty: Stewards have valuable context but may also have conflicts of interest or prefer favorable framing.

data.title: Source Systems Are Not Extractable Link Pools
data.claim: Source Systems Are Not Extractable Link Pools
data.uncertainty: Public-use ready as cautionary principle with caveats; do not treat as fully externally reviewed framework.
data.notes: Priority: Source systems should be treated as living knowledge environments with context, stewardship, structure, relationships, and update rhythms - not as raw link pools to scrape, flatten, absorb, or repackage. · Next: Add as core structural integrity principle; use before expanding deeply from any source system and to guide Batch 1B source-system deepening. · Notes: Added in Batch 1A Claims update.

data.title: Source systems are not extractable link pools
data.claim: Source systems are not extractable link pools
data.uncertainty: Do not publish as fact without status/caveats.
data.notes: Priority: Core source-system stewardship principle. · Next: Keep visible as protective claim; link to evidence/source context. · Notes: Integrity-protecting claim.

data.title: Southern feminist digital justice is one unified framework
data.claim: Southern feminist digital justice is one unified framework
data.interpretation: Name the specific source, tradition and argument rather than collapsing them into one category.
data.uncertainty: Feminist, transfeminist, antiracist, decolonial and development traditions contain differences and disagreements.
data.context: IT for Change / DAWN / Coding Rights

data.title: Speaker participation implies endorsement or formal partnership
data.claim: Speaker participation implies endorsement or formal partnership
data.interpretation: Record the exact role, event, and date; do not infer affiliation or endorsement beyond the source.
data.uncertainty: Event pages combine speakers, sponsors, partners, mentors, and community members with different relationships.

data.title: Standards reference is not standards conformance
data.claim: Standards reference is not standards conformance
data.uncertainty: Do not publish as fact without status/caveats.
data.notes: Priority: Mentioning CSIS/standards does not imply compliance. · Next: Keep visible as protective claim; link to evidence/source context. · Notes: Integrity-protecting claim.
data.review_needs: Discovery_Pool promotion — verify claim + evidence

data.title: Structured fields make cases directly comparable
data.claim: Structured fields make cases directly comparable
data.interpretation: Compare fields alongside narrative context, provenance, completeness, and source review.
data.uncertainty: Shared fields improve search and analysis but definitions, source quality, time periods, political contexts, and missingness still differ.

data.title: Support organization represents Indigenous authority
data.claim: Support organization represents Indigenous authority
data.interpretation: Cite support role clearly and prioritize direct Indigenous-government or community sources.
data.uncertainty: An ally or documentation organization may support rights without holding authority to define community governance.

data.title: System-dynamics scenarios predict a fixed future
data.claim: System-dynamics scenarios predict a fixed future
data.interpretation: Describe model structure, assumptions, scenarios, uncertainty and later evidence separately.
data.uncertainty: Models explore behavior under assumptions and scenarios; they are not date-specific prophecies.

data.title: Systems and standards language is politically neutral
data.claim: Systems and standards language is politically neutral
data.interpretation: Make authorship, positionality, decision rights, affected groups and contestability visible.
data.uncertainty: Models, standards, indicators and ontologies encode priorities, categories, exclusions and institutional power.

data.title: Systems thinking can replace political, historical or justice analysis
data.claim: Systems thinking can replace political, historical or justice analysis
data.interpretation: Use systems analysis alongside institutional, political-economy, design-justice and affected-party lenses.
data.uncertainty: Dynamic structure does not by itself explain colonialism, race, gender, labor, disability, ownership or contested interests.

data.title: Systems thinking is a politically neutral next lens
data.claim: Systems thinking is a politically neutral next lens
data.interpretation: Use systems thinking to expose dynamics while preserving conflict, history, positionality, and uncertainty.
data.uncertainty: System boundaries, variables, indicators, and causal stories reflect choices and power.

data.title: Taiwan's digital-democracy practices are a portable technology stack
data.claim: Taiwan's digital-democracy practices are a portable technology stack
data.interpretation: Treat Taiwan as a contextual implementation ecosystem and translate practices cautiously.
data.uncertainty: The ecosystem depends on political institutions, civic culture, public servants, communities, facilitation, law and long-term relationships—not only software.

data.title: Targeting women and youth proves equitable participation
data.claim: Targeting women and youth proves equitable participation
data.interpretation: Record participation, leadership, decision rights, burdens, benefits and follow-up separately.
data.uncertainty: Attendance and targeting do not establish authority, land control, compensation, safety, accessibility or long-term livelihood pathways.

data.title: Technical governance surfaces versus lived governance
data.claim: Technical governance surfaces versus lived governance
data.interpretation: Combine technical analysis with qualitative, historical, and affected-party evidence.
data.uncertainty: Contracts and data can reveal configurations while missing informal power, culture, off-chain negotiation, and enforcement.

data.title: Technological autonomy means independence from all external systems
data.claim: Technological autonomy means independence from all external systems
data.interpretation: Technological autonomy concerns meaningful community choice and control within acknowledged dependencies.
data.uncertainty: Community systems still depend on spectrum rules, backhaul, hardware, funding, energy, expertise and wider institutions.

data.title: Technology authorship ≠ system governance
data.claim: Technology authorship ≠ system governance
data.interpretation: Represent contribution and unresolved governance separately.
data.uncertainty: Authors, presenters and developers may contribute substantially without controlling corpus, infrastructure, budgets or releases.

data.title: Terms and privacy links establish adequate protection
data.claim: Terms and privacy links establish adequate protection
data.interpretation: Record that documents are linked and require project-specific data-flow and privacy review before safety claims.
data.uncertainty: Document availability does not prove project-specific minimization, safe logging, processor controls, deletion, incident response or territorial-data protection.

data.title: Territorial restoration reports are equivalent to verified ecological impact
data.claim: Territorial restoration reports are equivalent to verified ecological impact
data.interpretation: State ecological improvements as reported findings and identify the additional measurements and review needed.
data.uncertainty: Movement reports provide valuable situated evidence but do not supply standardized baselines, time series or independent verification.

data.title: The Batch 1C core set is a canonical civic-governance stack
data.claim: The Batch 1C core set is a canonical civic-governance stack
data.interpretation: Present the set as a curated working cluster and keep pathways open to other traditions, local systems and critiques.
data.uncertainty: The systems were selected for complementary source depth and Toolkit relevance, not as universal authorities or required infrastructure.

data.title: The Certificado Ecológico Boricuá was participatory
data.claim: The Certificado Ecológico Boricuá was participatory
data.interpretation: Describe it as a historical participatory-certification implementation lead; do not imply present operation.
data.uncertainty: Archived page states that farmers and consumers developed the ecological certificate.

data.title: The Climate Democracy Accelerator has launched more than 50 programs
data.claim: The Climate Democracy Accelerator has launched more than 50 programs
data.interpretation: People Powered reports more than 50 launched climate-action and citizen-engagement programs since 2023; evaluate projects individually.
data.uncertainty: This is a current organizer-reported cumulative count and does not by itself establish implementation quality or climate outcomes.

data.title: The current platform is infrastructure-sovereign because it uses open-source …
data.claim: The current platform is infrastructure-sovereign because it uses open-source components and a Chinese model
data.interpretation: Describe specific dependencies and decision rights; treat sovereignty as multidimensional and evidenced layer by layer.
data.uncertainty: Open code and non-US models do not establish control over compute, hosting, providers, licenses, budgets, skills or exit options.

data.title: The database can answer what participatory processes work best, for what purp…
data.claim: The database can answer what participatory processes work best, for what purposes, and under what conditions
data.interpretation: Use Participedia to generate hypotheses, identify cases, and support mixed-method comparison; combine it with stronger evaluation designs and local knowledge.
data.uncertainty: This is a valuable guiding question, but crowdsourced observational case data alone cannot resolve causal effectiveness or universal best practice.

data.title: The eight design principles are a universal governance checklist
data.claim: The eight design principles are a universal governance checklist
data.interpretation: Use the principles as empirically grounded review prompts, not as certification or universal design law.
data.uncertainty: The principles emerged from comparative study of long-enduring common-pool-resource institutions and require contextual interpretation.

data.title: The existence of a commons means community members agree on its legitimacy
data.claim: The existence of a commons means community members agree on its legitimacy
data.interpretation: Record whose legitimacy judgment is represented and preserve disagreement and exclusion.
data.uncertainty: Members, decision makers, nonmembers and affected outsiders may evaluate legitimacy differently.

data.title: The four clusters together cover institutional, economic, participatory, and …
data.claim: The four clusters together cover institutional, economic, participatory, and evaluative dimensions
data.interpretation: The first four clusters provide strong coverage of these dimensions while leaving important gaps in systems dynamics, care, labor, disability, race, gender, coloniality, and ecology.
data.uncertainty: This is a useful working categorization but not an exhaustive map of each thinker or the wider field.

data.title: The leverage-points list is a universal ranking of interventions
data.claim: The leverage-points list is a universal ranking of interventions
data.interpretation: Use the list to widen inquiry and compare intervention depth, not to automatically select the highest-ranked category.
data.uncertainty: The ordering is a teaching heuristic; actual feasibility, ethics, timing, power and context vary.

data.title: The Network, Consortium, Labs, and Fund create a coherent governance architec…
data.claim: The Network, Consortium, Labs, and Fund create a coherent governance architecture
data.interpretation: OpenCivics publicly describes four complementary organizing structures; their current mandates, activity, and relationships require direct evidence.
data.uncertainty: Named structures and diagrams may exceed the maturity of operational documentation or active programs.

data.title: The P2P Foundation Wiki is a validated encyclopedia
data.claim: The P2P Foundation Wiki is a validated encyclopedia
data.interpretation: Use the wiki to discover and map leads; resolve consequential claims through primary and independent sources.
data.uncertainty: The wiki is a rich observatory and discovery source, but pages vary in date, authorship, sourcing, and editorial review.

data.title: The Participedia dataset represents participation practices within a country …
data.claim: The Participedia dataset represents participation practices within a country or region
data.interpretation: Use the dataset for discovery, description, and carefully bounded comparison; do not infer national prevalence from record counts.
data.uncertainty: Coverage reflects contributor networks, language, teaching partnerships, available sources, and editorial capacity rather than representative sampling.

data.title: The Partner State is a ready-made governance model
data.claim: The Partner State is a ready-made governance model
data.interpretation: Use Partner State as a question about how public institutions can support commons while preserving autonomy and accountability.
data.uncertainty: The concept is a normative orientation, not a universally tested institutional design.

data.title: The Regen Brand Commons represents the governance of the entire Regen movement
data.claim: The Regen Brand Commons represents the governance of the entire Regen movement
data.interpretation: Describe the specific brand/mark governance scope and distinguish it from Regen Commons, Regen Network governance, and independent regen communities.
data.uncertainty: The initiative concerns a name, mark, and identity context and should not be conflated with every regenerative community or the broader knowledge commons.

data.title: The Regen Commons public website is a complete and coherent source of current…
data.claim: The Regen Commons public website is a complete and coherent source of current programs
data.interpretation: Treat the home and learning pages as current framing; verify projects, governance, stewards, and documentation through primary records before stronger use.
data.uncertainty: The domain currently combines strong commons-learning pages with generic About/Projects content and a missing documentation route.

data.title: The Registry Assistant scales verification
data.claim: The Registry Assistant scales verification
data.interpretation: The Registry Assistant is intended to support review preparation and analysis; verification authority and responsibility remain with the relevant human and institutional process.
data.uncertainty: AI can accelerate document processing while also introducing automation bias or errors in high-stakes ecological review.

data.title: The richer continuation record should simply replace the original row
data.claim: The richer continuation record should simply replace the original row
data.interpretation: Preserve every imported row and create a preferred synthesized record linked to them.
data.uncertainty: Replacement would erase provenance, earlier language, and evidence of how the record evolved.

data.title: The three answer modes establish that the system is user-centered
data.claim: The three answer modes establish that the system is user-centered
data.interpretation: Describe intended audiences and seek paid farmer, educator, technician and researcher evaluation.

data.interpretation: Pair transparent rules with discretion boundaries, appeals, retrospectives, and constitutional revision.
data.uncertainty: Rules can clarify process but cannot remove competing values, unequal resources, interpretation disputes, or strategic behavior.

data.claim: Unpaid care work is freely chosen community contribution
data.interpretation: Record workload, choice, compensation, constraints and decision power rather than assuming voluntariness.

data.claim: Verification improves legitimacy without tradeoffs
data.interpretation: Document why verification is needed, what data it uses, appeals and who may be excluded.
data.uncertainty: Authorization can introduce exclusion, privacy risk and bureaucratic burden.

data.interpretation: Record the attestor or verifier, scope, authority, method, conflicts, date, and review standard alongside the attestation.
data.uncertainty: A signature or attestation shows who accepted a statement, but not whether the person was independent, qualified, conflict-free, or correct.

data.interpretation: State which roles are volunteer, paid, reciprocal, or currently unfunded; identify sustainability risks and boundaries.

data.interpretation: Treat volunteer contribution as unevenly accessible and keep paid pathways for essential work.

data.claim: Volunteer maintenance demonstrates community health
data.interpretation: Track volunteer contribution alongside compensation, workload, turnover, care, and sustainability.
data.uncertainty: High unpaid effort can signal commitment but also burnout, exclusion, subsidy by privileged contributors, and institutional underfunding.

data.why_it_matters: Ecological asset registry, standards-development environment, technical ledger, and public library connecting methodologies, project registration, monitoring, reporting, verification, credit issuance, ecological data, and market infrastructure.
data.caution: Registry status, on-chain issuance, data anchoring, attestations, verification, and credit retirement each mean different things. None alone proves ecological outcomes, community legitimacy, additionality, permanence, or equitable benefit sharing. Place-based and Indigenous knowledge requires consent and context.
data.extraction_status: Ecological-claim and MRV workflows; methodology development and review histories; project-credit-batch lineage; data anchoring and attestation; open-source registry infrastructure; biodiversity, soil-carbon, marine-restoration, watershed, and biochar examples.
data.notes: Role: Core Batch 1B source system · Action: ADD

data.title: Rhizomatica
data.what_it_curates: Community mobile telephony; HERMES HF radio; Techio Comunitario; Indigenous Network Technician training; decentralized telecom and energy systems; policy and regulatory work.
data.why_it_matters: Supports communities to build and maintain self-governed communication and energy infrastructure through appropriate technology, regulatory work, training and direct accompaniment.
data.caution: Support organizations must not be represented as owners or representatives of community systems. Technical success does not establish cultural fit, consent, affordability or durable governance.
data.extraction_status: Technological autonomy; community-owned infrastructure; appropriate technology; emergency and intermittently connected communications; organizer and technician capacity building.
data.notes: Role: Core cluster source system / technical and organizational autonomy · Action: ADD

data.title: Sins Invalid
data.what_it_curates: 10 Principles of Disability Justice; movement resources; access guides; performance and cultural work; climate, language, reproductive, anti-carceral and international solidarity materials.
data.why_it_matters: Disabled-led movement and performance project that helped articulate disability justice, centering disabled Black, Indigenous, queer, trans, nonbinary and other people of color and linking access to collective liberation.
data.caution: Do not reduce disability justice to accessibility compliance or universal-design checklists. Sins Invalid is a movement source, not a certification body, and its principles require contextual and community-led interpretation.
data.extraction_status: Disability justice principles; leadership of those most impacted; interdependence; collective access; cross-movement solidarity; cultural production as movement infrastructure.
data.notes: Role: Core disability-justice source system / movement-building and cultural project · Action: ADD

data.title: Vikalp Sangam
data.what_it_curates: Stories and case materials; regional and thematic Sangams; Alternatives Framework; Alternatives Transformation Format; organizations and initiatives; videos and interviews; multilingual publications; statements; annual and national gatherings.
data.why_it_matters: An evolving Indian Alternatives Confluence launched in 2014 that documents, convenes and connects movements and organizations exploring ecologically sustainable, socially just and democratic pathways.
data.caution: The platform and facilitators should not displace featured communities or movements. Preserve authorship, location, language, source organization, internal disagreement and limits of self-reported cases.
data.extraction_status: Movement-authored alternatives; framework evolution; relational curation; confluence design; multilingual learning; self-assessment across interconnected dimensions; practice-to-policy and solidarity relationships.
data.notes: Role: Core movement-process and grounded-alternatives source system · Action: UPDATE
